item.description: • Quicklinks, Script Commands, and extension commands that take input now open their own screen, where you type the first value in the search field and fill in the rest below

• Search GIFs from GIPHY or KLIPY with animated previews, then paste, copy, or drag them into any app
  • See your recent and favorite GIFs before you type a search
  • Install Raycast extensions by pasting their Raycast Store links into Browse Extensions
  • Browse Extensions now recommends popular extensions that work great in Turbo
  • Change settings for Clipboard History, Snippets, AI, Search GIFs, window management, and each extension right in the launcher
  • Move sticky notes anywhere by dragging their header
  • Extensions with long lists now load more results as you scroll
  • The launcher always opens at full size, ready for results

• Search apps, files, commands, quicklinks, and system actions from one keyboard-first launcher
  • Clipboard history for text, images, files, links, and colors, with pinning and previews
  • Snippets that expand anywhere, with clipboard, date, and cursor placeholders
  • Calculator with units, time zones, dates, and live currency rates
  • AI with your own model: Apple Intelligence, any OpenAI-compatible API, or Ollama, with Quick AI, AI Chat, and AI Commands
  • Colored sticky notes on your desktop with Markdown and checklists
  • Capture text from anywhere on screen and scan QR codes and barcodes
  • Window management, emoji search, dictionary, and today's schedule
  • Runs Script Commands and many Raycast extensions with native views
